title: 第九章 拷打毛利小五郎
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

犹豫再三，柯南还是一咬牙，把那套衣服拿走了，改藏在地下室杂物间的深处。

不换地方的话早晚会被发现。一旦让对方察觉到工藤新一没死，就会长时间的赖在这里纠缠着小兰。

把衣服拿走，运气好对方待了一段时间没有察觉到工藤新一还活着的迹象，直接离开。

其实在工藤新一离开后，柯南的思维冷静了不少，他想到了另一种可能。

假工藤新一知道的太多了。

一晚上的时间，黑衣人既要冲洗从自己相机里拿走的底片，又要查清工藤新一的资料，还要了解工藤新一的人际关系，连小兰的事情都调查的一清二楚……可黑衣人能够预料到小兰今天会到工藤家来吗？还是说连园子、连工藤新一所有的朋友同学都调查过了？

这样再假设，假工藤新一已经把自己的家翻了个底朝天……不可能，这些调查量加在一起绝对不是一晚上可以完成的。

但如果是个本来就知道他的人际关系、本来就对这个家这栋房子了如指掌的人，上述的事项就几乎不需要调查。而关于自己跟踪黑衣人被偷袭喂药的前后细节，柯南也想起来了，除了在场三人以外，还有阿笠博士也听自己讲过了。

那，有没有人满足了上述的条件、还能从阿笠博士那里打听来自己被偷袭的事情、还有能力伪装成自己的脸、甚至喜欢搞怪、有可能去调戏小兰？

答案是柯南那神奇的母亲，工藤有希子。能够使出一手千变万化的易容术的知名女演员、古灵精怪的性格时常如同小女孩一般调皮的恶趣味女人。如果是她刚好近期回家，又从阿笠博士那里听说了自己被灌药变小的事情，搞这么一出恶作剧是完全有可能的！

尽管有这个猜测，但柯南绝对不会去试探。毕竟，没有识破老妈的恶作剧只是被嘲笑，可一旦是自己猜错了，后果难以承受。

渚琰·工藤新一其实也在庆幸柯南没跟上来，因为他根本不记得毛利侦探事务所具体在哪，只记得是在米花范围内，于是从工藤宅所在米花二丁目一路找下去。

如果记得住址就好了，他可以靠另一边剑勇正人翻地图来实时导航，但现在的问题就是没有地址。

刚走到米花三丁目的时候，工藤新一突然发现地上躺着一个钱包。

嗯？难道是幸运A发力了？

虽然他现在确实是身无分文的状态，但捡了钱包却据为己有这个行为貌似属于侵占遗失物罪，不符合工藤新一光之魔人的人设啊。这分明是个拿了钱就会扣扮演度的陷阱。

上交派出所找到失主后倒是有权获得相当于遗失物品价值5%至20%的“报劳金”，不过聊胜于无。

不对，钱不是重点。工藤新一抽出了其中的证件，一张熟悉的老脸映入眼帘。

毛利小五郎，住址米花町五丁目39番地。

原来如此，正发愁不知道地址的时候就捡到了毛利小五郎的钱包，这才是幸运A的真正力量吗？

来到了证件上的地址。果然看到了那熟悉的，贴有‘毛利侦探事务所’的玻璃窗。

还未等他上楼，就听见了从三楼传来毛利小五郎的大吼大叫。

“不行！还没出嫁的女儿突然要跑到别的男生家住，就算是那个臭屁侦探小子也不行！”

“都说了只是因为新一受伤了，我帮忙照顾一段时间而已！顺便让柯南住在新一家，比跟你挤在一起强多了！”

“绝对不能接受！我才不想这么快就把独生女儿嫁出去！怎么说也要等到十年以后吧！而且要让他当面给我土下座，说‘岳父大人请把女儿交给我’才行！！”

“你在说什么疯话啊爸爸！”

“岳父大人，请把女儿交给我！——是这样吗？”一个声音从旁边插入进来，声音还不小。

毛利小五郎一开始还没反应过来：“没错，就是这样！而且土下座时屁股一定要撅的够高！”

接着猛地一回头：“侦探小子——！！”那眼珠子瞪得，比见了鬼的时候都大。

“新一！”小兰也吓了一跳，想不到这家伙这时候添乱。小兰立刻动身，推搡着工藤新一的胸口把他推出门外，一直到工藤新一的后背挨着楼梯间的墙壁。

“你怎么来了？”小兰有些慌张地问道。

Page (1/3)

After much hesitation, Conan gritted his teeth, took away the suit of clothes, and hid them deep in the basement utility room.

If you don't change places, you will be discovered sooner or later.Once the other party realizes that Kudou Shinichi is not dead, he will stay here to pester Xiaolan for a long time.

He took the clothes away, and luckily the other party didn't notice any sign that Kudou Shinichi was still alive after staying for a while, so he left directly.

In fact, after Kudo Shinichi left, Conan's thinking calmed down a lot, and he thought of another possibility.

Fake Kudo Shinichi knows too much.

In one night, the man in black had to develop the films taken from his camera, find out Kudo Shinichi's information, and understand Kudo Shinichi's interpersonal relationships. He even investigated Xiaolan's affairs... But could the man in black predict that Xiaolan would come to Kudo's house today?Or have you said that even Sonoko and all of Kudo Shinichi’s friends and classmates have been investigated?

Let's assume that the fake Kudo Shinichi has turned his home upside down... Impossible. The total amount of investigations cannot be completed in one night.

But if it is a person who already knows about his interpersonal relationships and knows this house well, there is almost no need to investigate the above matters.Conan also remembered the details of how he followed the man in black and was sneak-attacked and fed him medicine. In addition to the three people present, Dr. A Li also heard him tell it.

So, is there anyone who meets the above conditions, can still find out from Dr. Ali about being attacked by a sneak attack, has the ability to disguise himself as his own face, even likes to be funny, and maybe molests Xiaolan?

The answer is Conan’s magical mother, Yukiko Kudo.A well-known actress who can use ever-changing disguise techniques, and a woman with an eccentric personality who is often as naughty as a little girl.If she happened to go home recently and heard from Dr. Ali that she had been given medicine to shrink in size, it would be entirely possible for her to pull off such a prank!

Despite this speculation, Conan would never test it.After all, if you don't see through your mother's prank, you will just be laughed at, but if you guess wrong, the consequences will be unbearable.

Nagisa Kudo Shinichi was actually glad that Conan didn't follow him, because he didn't remember the specific location of the Mori Detective Agency at all. He only remembered that it was within the area of ​​rice flower, so he searched all the way from the rice flower 2-chome where Kudo's residence was.

It would be nice if he remembered the address. He could rely on the other side Jian Yongzhengren to flip the map for real-time navigation, but the problem now is that there is no address.

When he arrived at Rice Flower 3-chome, Kudo Shinichi suddenly found a wallet lying on the ground.

Um?Could it be that Lucky A has exerted his strength?

Although he is indeed penniless now, the act of picking up the wallet and keeping it as his own seems to be a crime of misappropriation of lost property, which is not in line with the character of Kudo Shinichi: Demon of Light.This is obviously a trap where the performance level will be deducted if you take the money.

After turning it in to the police station and finding the owner, you are entitled to a "reimbursement payment" equivalent to 5% to 20% of the value of the lost item, but it is better than nothing.

No, money is not the point.Kudo Shinichi took out the certificate, and a familiar old face came into view.

Mouri Kogoro, whose address is No. 39, 5-chome, Yoneka-cho.

So it turns out that when I was worried about not knowing the address, I picked up Mouri Kogoro's wallet. Is this the real power of Lucky A?

Came to the address on the certificate.Sure enough, I saw the familiar glass window with the word 'Maori Detective Agency' on it.

Before he went upstairs, he heard Mouri Kogoro yelling from the third floor.

"No! My unmarried daughter suddenly wants to live with another boy, not even that stinky detective boy!"

"As I said, it's just because Shinichi was injured and I helped take care of him for a while! By the way, letting Conan live with the Shinichi family is much better than being squeezed together with you!"

"Absolutely unacceptable! I don't want to marry off my only daughter so soon! No matter what, I have to wait until ten years later! And I have to make him sit down in front of me and say, 'Father-in-law, please give me your daughter'!!"

"What crazy talk are you talking about, Dad!"

"Father-in-law, please hand over your daughter to me! - Is that so?" A voice came in from the side, and the voice was not quiet.

Mouri Kogoro didn't react at first: "Yes, that's it! And when Doge sits down, your butt must be raised high enough!"

Then he turned around suddenly: "Detective boy——!!" His eyes were widened, even bigger than when he saw a ghost.

"Shinichi!" Xiaolan was also startled, not expecting this guy to cause trouble at this time.Xiaolan immediately started to push Kudo Shinichi's chest and pushed him out of the door until Kudo Shinichi's back was against the wall of the stairwell.

"Why are you here?" Xiaolan asked in a panic.
